hed: House Rules clears Graham Russia–Iran sanctions; floor rule vote set Tuesday
dek: The House Rules Committee voted 7–3 late Monday to advance a rule for the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026 (H.R. 5334), clearing a procedural path after the Senate’s 86–11 August passage. Debate on the House rule was expected around noon Tuesday Eastern; if the rule passes, final passage is teed for Wednesday before an extended recess. Democrats continue to object to expanded presidential tariff authority in the package.

byline: Event summary from public reporting and named outlets

cl.body: RFE/RL’s Tuesday Rules wrap, Fox News’s Democratic tariff-dilemma piece, and The Hill’s committee coverage emphasize Meeks/Neal/Beyer objections that the bill expands presidential tariff power while failing to mandate Russia sanctions — a procedural Tuesday rule vote still standing between the Senate-passed text and any Wednesday floor outcome.

cr.body: TASS’s Tuesday committee wire, Bloomberg’s prior scheduling report, and Speaker-side scheduling notes frame the 7–3 Rules advance as moving Graham’s Russia/Iran package — including secondary tariffs on top Russian energy buyers — onto the Tuesday rule calendar with a possible Wednesday final vote before the House’s midterm recess.
